title: An ageing population
paragraphs: There’s one thing for certain – we’re all getting older. And while the older amongst us may be no spring chickens any more, growing old gracefully is no bad thing. And with age comes wisdom. However, as the world population ages, will there be enough people to replace our younger selves?

A situation where there are more old people than young certainly has an effect on the world. A report by the Pew Research Center says that globally the number of people over 65 years old will triple by 2050, drastically altering some countries’ demographic make-up.

This growing and dependent population means that there is an increased demand for health and social care. Governments will struggle to provide satisfactory pensions, which are ultimately funded by taxes paid by the working population. And long-term, a smaller population of economically-active people may be a problem for companies trying to recruit staff.

Attitudes to an ageing population vary around the world. The Pew Research Center survey found that 87% of Japanese people were most concerned about it, while only 26% of people from the USA were. Here, immigration is helping to boost the younger workforce. Some countries thought the elderly should take care of themselves, while others thought it was the responsibility of the family. Many thought the government should be responsible.

But old age shouldn’t just be seen negatively. Elderly people have knowledge and experience they can pass on. Some have wealth which they can spend, helping the economy. And some help society by doing voluntary or charity work.

Of course, solutions are needed to tackle the issue, and these include increasing the retirement age, encouraging people to save for the future, persuading skilled and educated migrants to fill labour shortages, or even convincing people to have more children.

vocabulary.entry: demographic make-up /ˌdeməˈɡræfɪk ˈmeɪkʌp/ n. 人口结构
vocabulary.example: The demographic make-up of the region has changed a lot in the past decade.
vocabulary.translation: 过去十年间，该地区的人口结构发生了很大变化。

vocabulary.entry: dependent population /dɪˈpendənt ˌpɒpjuˈleɪʃn/ n. 受扶养人口
vocabulary.example: A large dependent population may put pressure on the social security system.
vocabulary.translation: 庞大的受扶养人口可能会给社会保障体系带来压力。

vocabulary.entry: pension /ˈpenʃn/ n. 养老金；退休金
vocabulary.example: He receives a monthly pension after retiring from the company.
vocabulary.translation: 他从公司退休后，每月都能领取养老金。

vocabulary.entry: economically-active /ˌiːkəˈnɒmɪkli ˈæktɪv/ adj. 有经济活动能力的；劳动适龄的
vocabulary.example: The economically-active population is the main contributor to tax revenue.
vocabulary.translation: 劳动适龄人口是税收的主要贡献者。

vocabulary.entry: recruit /rɪˈkruːt/ v. 招聘；招募
vocabulary.example: The company is looking to recruit a new marketing manager.
vocabulary.translation: 这家公司正在招聘一名新的市场营销经理。

vocabulary.entry: immigration /ˌɪmɪˈɡreɪʃn/ n. 移民；移居入境
vocabulary.example: Immigration has played an important role in the country's development.
vocabulary.translation: 移民对这个国家的发展起到了重要作用。

vocabulary.entry: workforce /ˈwɜːkfɔːs/ n. 劳动力；劳动人口
vocabulary.example: The factory is facing a shortage of skilled workforce.
vocabulary.translation: 这家工厂正面临熟练劳动力短缺的问题。

vocabulary.entry: voluntary work /ˈvɒləntri wɜːk/ n. 志愿工作
vocabulary.example: She does voluntary work at the local community center every weekend.
vocabulary.translation: 她每个周末都会在当地社区中心做志愿工作。

vocabulary.entry: charity work /ˈtʃærəti wɜːk/ n. 慈善工作
vocabulary.example: His charity work focuses on helping homeless children.
vocabulary.translation: 他的慈善工作主要是帮助无家可归的儿童。

vocabulary.entry: retirement age /rɪˈtaɪəmənt eɪdʒ/ n. 退休年龄
vocabulary.example: The government plans to raise the retirement age gradually.
vocabulary.translation: 政府计划逐步提高退休年龄。

vocabulary.entry: labour shortage /ˈleɪbə ˈʃɔːtɪdʒ/ n. 劳动力短缺
vocabulary.example: The construction industry is suffering from a serious labour shortage.
vocabulary.translation: 建筑业正面临严重的劳动力短缺问题。

vocabulary.entry: triple /ˈtrɪpl/ v. 增至三倍；使成三倍
vocabulary.example: The company's profits have tripled in just one year.
vocabulary.translation: 这家公司的利润在短短一年内增长到了原来的三倍。

vocabulary.entry: drastically /ˈdræstɪkli/ adv. 彻底地；急剧地
vocabulary.example: The new policy has drastically changed people's daily lives.
vocabulary.translation: 这项新政策彻底改变了人们的日常生活。

vocabulary.entry: ultimately /ˈʌltɪmətli/ adv. 最终；归根结底
vocabulary.example: All efforts will ultimately lead to success if we persist.
vocabulary.translation: 只要我们坚持下去，所有的努力最终都会带来成功。

vocabulary.entry: tax /tæks/ n. 税；税款
vocabulary.example: People who earn above a certain amount must pay income tax.
vocabulary.translation: 收入超过一定数额的人必须缴纳个人所得税。

vocabulary.entry: attitude /ˈætɪtjuːd/ n. 态度；看法
vocabulary.example: Her positive attitude towards life is very inspiring.
vocabulary.translation: 她积极的人生态度非常鼓舞人心。

vocabulary.entry: vary /ˈveəri/ v. 不同；有差异
vocabulary.example: Customs vary from one country to another.
vocabulary.translation: 各国的风俗习惯各不相同。

vocabulary.entry: concern /kənˈsɜːn/ v. 担忧；关心
vocabulary.example: Many people are concerned about the environmental problems.
vocabulary.translation: 很多人都在担忧环境问题。

vocabulary.entry: boost /buːst/ v. 增加；促进
vocabulary.example: The new project will boost the local economy significantly.
vocabulary.translation: 这个新项目将极大地促进当地经济发展。

vocabulary.entry: responsibility /rɪˌspɒnsəˈbɪləti/ n. 责任；职责
vocabulary.example: Taking care of the elderly is a family responsibility in many cultures.
vocabulary.translation: 在许多文化中，赡养老人是家庭的责任。

vocabulary.entry: negative /ˈneɡətɪv/ adj. 负面的；消极的
vocabulary.example: Don't have a negative view of everything around you.
vocabulary.translation: 不要对身边的一切都抱有消极的看法。

vocabulary.entry: pass on /pɑːs ɒn/ v. 传承；传递
vocabulary.example: The old craftsman hopes to pass on his skills to the younger generation.
vocabulary.translation: 这位老工匠希望把自己的手艺传承给年轻一代。

vocabulary.entry: tackle /ˈtækl/ v. 处理；应对
vocabulary.example: We need to find effective ways to tackle this problem.
vocabulary.translation: 我们需要找到有效的方法来应对这个问题。

vocabulary.entry: migrant /ˈmaɪɡrənt/ n. 移民；移居者
vocabulary.example: Skilled migrants are welcome in this country.
vocabulary.translation: 这个国家欢迎技术型移民。

vocabulary.entry: contributor /kənˈtrɪbjətə(r)/ n. 贡献者；促成因素
vocabulary.example: Education is an important contributor to social progress.
vocabulary.translation: 教育是社会进步的重要促成因素。

sentences.english: There’s one thing for certain – we’re all getting older.
sentences.chinese: 有一件事是肯定的——我们都在慢慢变老。

sentences.english: And while the older amongst us may be no spring chickens any more, growing old gracefully is no bad thing.
sentences.chinese: 虽然我们当中的年长者早已不再年轻，但优雅地老去并非坏事，毕竟岁月会赋予人智慧。

sentences.english: And with age comes wisdom. However, as the world population ages, will there be enough people to replace our younger selves?
sentences.chinese: 然而，随着全球人口老龄化程度加深，未来会有足够的年轻人来接替我们吗？

sentences.english: A situation where there are more old people than young certainly has an effect on the world.
sentences.chinese: 老年人口数量超过年轻人口，这种情况必然会对世界产生影响。

sentences.english: A report by the Pew Research Center says that globally the number of people over 65 years old will triple by 2050, drastically altering some countries’ demographic make-up.
sentences.chinese: 皮尤研究中心的一份报告指出，到2050年，全球65岁以上的人口数量将增至三倍，这会彻底改变一些国家的人口结构。

sentences.english: This growing and dependent population means that there is an increased demand for health and social care.
sentences.chinese: 这类数量日益增长的受扶养人口，意味着对医疗和社会保障服务的需求会增加。

sentences.english: Governments will struggle to provide satisfactory pensions, which are ultimately funded by taxes paid by the working population.
sentences.chinese: 各国政府将努力提供令人满意的养老金，毕竟养老金的资金最终来自就业人群缴纳的税收。

sentences.english: And long-term, a smaller population of economically-active people may be a problem for companies trying to recruit staff.
sentences.chinese: 从长远来看，劳动适龄人口的减少，可能会给企业招聘员工带来难题。

sentences.english: Attitudes to an ageing population vary around the world.
sentences.chinese: 世界各地对人口老龄化的态度不尽相同。

sentences.english: The Pew Research Center survey found that 87% of Japanese people were most concerned about it, while only 26% of people from the USA were.
sentences.chinese: 皮尤研究中心的调查显示，87%的日本人对此最为担忧，而美国仅有26%的人关注这一问题。

sentences.english: Here, immigration is helping to boost the younger workforce.
sentences.chinese: 在美国，移民正助力扩充年轻劳动力群体。

sentences.english: Some countries thought the elderly should take care of themselves, while others thought it was the responsibility of the family. Many thought the government should be responsible.
sentences.chinese: 有些国家认为老年人应该自理，有些国家则认为赡养老人是家庭的责任，还有很多人认为政府应该负责。

sentences.english: But old age shouldn’t just be seen negatively.
sentences.chinese: 当然，我们不应只从负面视角看待老龄化。

sentences.english: Elderly people have knowledge and experience they can pass on. Some have wealth which they can spend, helping the economy. And some help society by doing voluntary or charity work.
sentences.chinese: 老年人拥有可以传承的知识和经验，部分老年人有可支配的财富，消费后能推动经济发展，还有些老年人会通过志愿服务或慈善活动为社会贡献力量。

sentences.english: Of course, solutions are needed to tackle the issue, and these include increasing the retirement age, encouraging people to save for the future, persuading skilled and educated migrants to fill labour shortages, or even convincing people to have more children.
sentences.chinese: 要解决人口老龄化问题，自然需要找到对应的方案，比如提高退休年龄、鼓励人们为未来储蓄、劝导技术型和高学历移民来填补劳动力缺口，甚至鼓励人们生育更多子女。
